# Choosing between sops-nix and agenix

## Thesis

Both **sops-nix** and **agenix** decrypt secrets at activation. Pick **whichever your team already encrypts with**. Comparison after `02-sops-nix` and `03-agenix`. `nix` is not on this writer host — re-verify flake input versions locally.

## Mental model

```text
  sops-nix: structured SOPS → age/GPG/KMS
  agenix:   age files → small module surface
```

| Concern | sops-nix | agenix |
|---------|----------|--------|
| Format | SOPS YAML/JSON | age files |
| Recipients | age, GPG, KMS | age / SSH keys |
| Fit | existing SOPS shops | age-only minimal setups |

## Worked examples

Checklist: existing SOPS+KMS → sops-nix; age-only + small audit surface → agenix; need one system of record → never both.

## Trap

**Running both modules on one host.** Two decryption paths, two failure modes.

## Boring rule

One secret system per fleet; document recipients in the flake README.

## Try this

1. Encrypt one secret both ways in a scratch flake.
2. Read the sibling how-to chapters side by side.
3. Check current flake input versions before copying snippets.
